phase_order_and_guards: 0. Validate exact new contract/plan/independent receipt, four-arm closed scientific review decision, scalar terminal status, serial lock and absent/fresh output; validate all bound hashes. No old A/B candidate activation.

1. Preallocate all fixed selected-scope rows. Rebuild both epsilon tapes, require both raw-byte saved-z matches; select B indices, build B z, choose C permutations and build C z, reconstruct/verify g only if D prospectively enabled. Seal epsilon, indices, B/C tensors, g and permutation inputs before ANY model construction or forward. No natural model in input preparation.

2. Load only final CE VAE with strict state dict, weights_only=True; verify checkpoint byte hash and loaded full tensor digest. eval + torch.no_grad, CPU one thread, protect/restore global RNG during model initialization. No optimizer/encoder/DDPM.

3. If D enabled, in FREE then AMD order perform exactly one inverse-flow and one forward-roundtrip per terminal. Any failure aborts; preserve D intermediate tensors and leave pending decoder slots not_executed. No fallback to a B/C-only success after D was selected. Seal all final decoder inputs including D before first decoder call.

4. Call unchanged frozen decode(model,z,categorical_ce,observations) in fixed order B_FREE,B_AMD,C_FREE,C_AMD,D_FREE,D_AMD (omit D only if prospectively disabled). No flow for DDPM/B/C. Per batch finite z/raw/J; preserve empty and full48; no filtering or clipping.

5. Finally retain all slots, tracebacks, intermediate tensors, per-phase and supervisor costs, actual call counters, before/after input hashes and full model tensor digests. A failure stops pending calls, does not resample/retry; completed results remain visible. No modification to original runs or reports.
